segments.text: How to enable telemetry in Business Central online environments. To enable telemetry for a Business Central online environment, you go to the tenant admin center and pick the environment.
In this case, I have an environment called DK Sandbox. And in the details menu here, I have an ability to set application insights connection string.
Let me click this define. And this opens up a new menu where I can put in a connection string that will allow Business Central to start emitting telemetry to this application insights resource.
Be aware that this will trigger if if you save this, it will trigger restart of the environment. So, please don't do this during working hours.

But I will just click enable application insights and then I need to supply a connection string. How do I get that? Well, we simply need to go to the Azure portal to our application insights resource and get it there.
Let's do that. So, here in the Azure portal on the front page of my application insights resource, I have a menu called essentials on the front page and here I have connection string.
So, I simply go to the right and click copy to clipboard. And this is the connection string I need to put into the tenant admin center. So, let's go back there.
I click connection string field and I paste my connection string in here. And when I click save, again important, this will trigger an environment
uh restart. When I click save, this will inject the connection string into Business Central and within a few minutes, you now start getting data.
That's how easy it is to enable telemetry on a Business Central environment.
